messages:
ajay: Quick sync — we need final owners for the v2 routing fallback + SDK compatibility before next week's deploy. Two blockers I want clear ownership on: (1) routing policy fallback mapping for model variants, (2) SDK behavior for 404/410 deprecations. Who takes rollout owner and who owns SDK compat PRs? cc @maria @simon

maria: I can take routing fallback ownership. I'll own the mapping + tests. ETA Wed EOD. Need the version mapping matrix from platform to start.

simon: I can own SDK compat (feature flag + migration docs). Quick question: do we surface 410 as an immediate error, or attempt a mapping to an older model variant by default?

ajay: Policy we discussed earlier — prefer graceful fallback to a compatible variant in ~95% of cases. 410 should be surfaced to clients only when no fallback is available. We'll also add metrics to track fallback rates. @karla can you produce the mapping matrix by Tue?

karla: I can generate it. Which columns do you need? I was thinking: model_family, variant, quantization, seq_len_profile, recommended_fallback, estimated_p95_latency. I'll dump as CSV to the shared drive.

maria: For tests, include expected p95 latency buckets per mapping — that affects routing rules (e.g., avoid fallback if p95 > 200ms in low-latency routes).

karla: Will include p50/p95 and a simple `latency_class` column (low/med/high).

simon: SDK plan: default to raising DeprecatedModelError unless user opts into fallback via flag `allow_legacy_fallback=true`. Also plan to emit telemetry events `sdk.fallback_used` and `sdk.deprecation_error`. Is that aligned?

ajay: Yep. Telemetry names look good. Add `sdk.fallback_variant` string property so we can tie which variant was used. Also add a rate-limited log line for fallback to help debugging.

simon: Got it. I'll add the flag + events. Also need an owner for release notes / migration guide. @nina?

nina: I can draft the release note + migration guide. Will sync with Simon for code examples. Need final API semantics by Thu to finish examples.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Release window booked for 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC — please confirm owners for the rollout.

ajay: :thumbsup: Confirmed. Owners: Maria (routing fallback), Simon (SDK compat), Karla (mapping matrix), Nina (docs). I'll coordinate the rollout and be primary on-call for any cross-team escalation.

maria: :rocket: Started branch `routing/fallback-v2` and adding unit tests for mapping table.

simon: Opened PR #4823 for SDK changes, tagging @ajay for review. Noticed one flaky test in CI related to canary — env var `SDK_ALLOW_FALLBACK=true` needed in canary config.

ajay: I can review today and update canary config once Karla uploads the matrix.

karla: CSV uploaded: https://redwood-internal/share/v2-routing-matrix.csv (contains mapping + latency columns). I'll update if we get new model variants.

nina: Draft WIP in docs repo: `docs/migration/v2-fallback.md` (PR coming). Will pull examples from Simon's branch.

ajay: Thanks all. Let's keep async updates here. If anything blocks Wed EOD owners should ping me directly. Reconvene async Thu morning for final thumbs.

maria: Quick note — test harness needs a stub for `fallback_decision()` to simulate high latency; I'll add that to the branch.

simon: Also adding a small compatibility test that asserts `DeprecatedModelError` when flag=false and fallback metric increments when true.

ajay: Perfect. If there are infra blockers, loop in eng-infra early. Otherwise aim for Friday canary and Monday ramp if green.

maria: ack.

simon: ack.

(threads end)
